report:
**PASS — Standards / Spec / Maintainability.** Reviewed the snapshot manifest, all four payloads, and the three actual diagnostic records. The prepared helper’s proposed max-two route is obsolete: the authorized dispatch and driver require exactly one attempt, zero retries, no fallback, 120 seconds, and 512 tokens. The driver checks the approved grant and exact request shape before sending; it records no headers or raw provider error text. Error categories and parameters are finite allowlists, message-derived hints are explicitly non-authoritative, and the cloned error body is capped at 8192 bytes with only hashes and bounded signals retained. Offline evidence covers synthetic SDK responses and negative guards; it does not establish real provider behavior.

The preservation record reports one prior HTTP 400 attempt, unchanged original project files, and no fallback or retry; it does not prove successful research or fallback integration. **No blocker found for the requested audit-only diagnostic scope.** I did not run scripts, invoke providers, or modify files.
